summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend validation of the NEW Full 4-skill Mock + Speaking exam features. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_full_mock_speaking.py (Full Mock listing with 4 sections in correct order, no accepted_answers/explanation leak, server-timer authority on refresh, save answers + speaking multipart upload + submit -> combined result, listening/reading bands immediate, writing+speaking QUEUED->COMPLETED via Gemini within ~45s, overall_band == half-band-rounded avg of the 4 skill bands, duplicate submit returns already:true with same result_id, save-after-submit -> 409, Speaking standalone with part/prep_seconds/speak_seconds fields, per-question audio upload, GET /attempts/{aid}/speaking/audio/{qnum} returns mime+b64 for owner and 403 for another student, speaking evaluation_id set on skills.speaking with 4 criteria fluency_coherence/lexical_resource/grammatical_range/pronunciation). Frontend (Playwright): login as student ok, Mock Tests page lists Full IELTS Mock Test 1 and Speaking Practice Test 1, ExamIntro rules->Start Exam works, ExamRunner shows data-testid='exam-timer' (169:56) and data-testid='mock-progress' stepper labeled Listening/Reading/Writing/Speaking, 'Next section' advances listening->reading->writing->speaking, speaking section renders data-testid='speaking-device-check' with 'start-device-check-btn', Speaking standalone also shows device-check immediately, result detail page for the Full Mock renders Overall Band 1.0, per-skill bands (Listening/Reading/Writing/Speaking), and data-testid='speaking-feedback' section.

minor.issue: Transcription errors are swallowed silently (transcript='') — that's acceptable for the demo but there is no observability (no log/status flag). Consider setting rec.status='transcribe_failed' when transcribe_audio raises so QA/teachers can see it.

If the speaking Gemini eval fails, skills.speaking.status='FAILED' is set but the result 'status' is recomputed to COMPLETED excluding the missing band — overall_band will average only the succeeded skills (may be misleadingly high/low). Consider surfacing 'partial_completion' flag.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/exam_router.py _finalize_attempt: `has_pending` block computes overall_band twice with a ternary that always calls overall_band(bands) — simplify to `overall_band(bands) if bands else None` (or None while pending) for clarity.

routers/exam_router.py speaking_upload: transcription runs inline on the request path — for long uploads this could exceed HTTP timeout. Consider deferring to a background task (asyncio.create_task) and storing transcript later.

routers/ai_router.py has TWO overall recompute helpers (_recompute_result_overall) duplicated with recompute_overall in exam_router — same duplication called out in iteration_1; still not extracted to a shared module.

SpeakingStage.jsx: uploadRecording retries at most once. If the network is flaky and both fail, the student cannot easily 'submit anyway' — the Submit Speaking button is disabled until statuses[q.number] is truthy for every question. Consider a 'Skip / mark absent' path or allow submitting with failed uploads.

SpeakingStage.jsx: MediaRecorder stream is created from a single getUserMedia call at device-check; if that stream is stopped by the browser (tab hidden long enough) recording will silently produce empty blobs. No re-acquire logic.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the new Full Mock + Speaking UI paths tested

seed_data_creation: Test only registered a second student (other_*@example.com) for the 403 audio-retrieval assertion. Full Mock and Speaking exam attempts + results are persisted for the sample student — safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new Full Mock + Speaking flows are green. Re-run: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_full_mock_speaking.py -v -o addopts=''` (project pytest.ini forces -n=auto via xdist so pass -o addopts='' to disable and get clean output). Whisper on the dummy webm often returns empty transcript — the eval still produces a band from Gemini using the '(no speech recorded)' fallback. The frontend uses shadcn Radix checkbox (role=checkbox) on ExamIntro — Playwright's .check() on native input won't work; use page.locator('[role="checkbox"]').click(force=True).
